chunks: In this surely is a sign for him who fears the torment of the Hereafter, the day when mankind will be assembled together, which will be a day when all things would become evident.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the day of gathering and witnessing in the Hereafter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of the Day of Judgment as a definitive proof for the God-fearing, linking the cosmic gathering to the concept of 'Yawm al-Mashhood' (the Witnessed Day). It reinforces the Shia emphasis on accountability, where the collective assembly serves as a tangible manifestation of divine justice and the ultimate reality of the Hereafter.
